chunks: O believers, come to full submission to God. Do not follow in the footsteps of Satan your acknowledged foe.

key_terms.السِّلْمِ: Submission or peace, referring to complete acceptance of God's will
key_terms.خُطُوَاتِ: Footsteps, referring to following the path or actions of
key_terms.کَافَّةً: All together, completely, or in entirety

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to enter into 'silm' (submission) completely in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a call for comprehensive submission to God's will, extending beyond mere ritual to encompass all aspects of life, while 'Silm' (peace/submission) is seen as the antithesis of 'Harb' (war/strife) promoted by Satan. The warning against following Satan's 'footsteps' (khutuwat) highlights the gradual nature of deviation, urging believers to maintain consistency in their faith to avoid the fragmentation that leads to spiritual defeat.
